app.name: RemoteJob.club
app.description: Curated remote jobs from verified company career pages. No ghost jobs, no expired listings, no recruiter spam. AI-powered resume matching included.

intents.name: Get Featured Jobs
intents.description: Get curated remote job listings from verified company career pages. Returns up to 15 jobs for anonymous users, up to 70 for authenticated users. No ghost jobs or expired listings.

limit.description: Number of jobs to return. Max 15 for anonymous, 70 for authenticated.

intents.name: Authenticate User
intents.description: Log in to RemoteJob.club to unlock up to 70 curated remote job listings instead of 15.
triggers: I want to see more jobs

intents.name: AI Resume Match
intents.description: Upload a resume to get up to 30 AI-matched remote jobs ranked by fit. Uses the Terminal feature to analyse your resume against verified job listings.
triggers: find jobs that match my resume
find best remote jobs for me

resume.description: Resume file in PDF or plain text format, base64 encoded

returns.description: Up to 30 remote jobs ranked by AI match score against the uploaded resume

intents.name: Get Job Detail
intents.description: Get full details of a specific remote job listing including company, role, requirements, and application link.
triggers: tell me more about this role
what are the requirements for this job
how do I apply for this job

job_id.description: Unique identifier of the job listing
